fields.name: Royal Palms Convention Center

fields.owner_response_notes: Delighted to host your wedding reception!

fields.comment: Exceptional venue! The stage lighting and centralized AC kept 400 guests comfortable throughout the summer evening. Highly recommended!
fields.owner_response: Thank you Ananya! It was our privilege to host your family celebration.
